root_cause.category: task-contract/runner incompatibility outside candidate scope (not a candidate adapter defect)
root_cause.detail: TASK-006 pinned verify.toml CHK-003 runs `tc-proof oracle --namespace components`. prepare binds family=native + single-observer sequence (correct per observer_family_for_check: non-empty non-synthetic namespace). At runtime run_oracle calls validate_oracle_namespace FIRST, which rejects 'components' because NATIVE_ORACLE_NAMESPACES={showcase,holla,jackin,tablepro} (tools/refactor-proof/runner/context.py:40, bundled bin/tc-proof:314, introduced by b96a62e4 'still rejects unknown namespaces'). Worker writes rejected/PROTOCOL with zero observation digests and exits 1; CHK-007 close then rejects CLOSURE on the failed prior. Verified by direct execution of the exact function (REJECTED category=PROTOCOL) and reject-category audit of every earlier-or-equal check in run_oracle order (guard=CONTEXT_INDEX, source=SOURCE, required=REQUIRED_SET; only namespace yields pre-observer PROTOCOL). TASK-006 is the sole task using --namespace components; no integrated task added runner support for it and 006's writable set (tools/refactor-proof-adapters/components only) forbids runner changes. Fix requires either runner namespace support (a task with tools/refactor-proof scope) or a task-package change (coordinator decision; task packages are frozen/forbidden to candidates).
